title: coax can resume a session by id from its command line
body:
coax loads an earlier session only from its interactive picker (`src/picker.rs`, and the "load" choice in `src/main.rs`). Its command line is `coax [--prompt <text>] [--allow] [--agent <name> | <agent command> [args...]]`. coax reports to decade over the decade socket (`src/report.rs`), and the report's `Agent` holds the agent's name, version and session id.

decade is to resume a coax session when it restores a workspace (decade's issue decade-cf942a). For that, decade has to start coax on a given session with the flags it was first started with.

## Proposal

- `--session <id>`, given with `--agent <name>`, loads that session through the agent's session loading, in place of the picker. An id the agent does not know is an error coax reports before it starts.
- The report's `Agent` carries `args`, the flags coax was started with, minus `--prompt` and its text and minus `--session` and its id. decade saves them and passes them back on resume. The field comes from `decade-channel`'s `Agent`, which gains `args` in the same change.

Jack signed off on 2026-11-22.
